text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible cheer...
As expected of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet is running today!
I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Who else is there... Oh, Air Shakur's here.
Huh, she's still running?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She had a good Classic year, but... come to think of it, I hadn't heard her name lately. I'd almost forgotten she was a Double Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's got their peak, ya know?
Two crowns is amazing. Should've just left it at that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... She could've become a legend, too.
Ah, speaking of the other girls, though—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay.
Shakur... won't lose."
choice_data_list: Honestly, it's going to be a pretty tough race for her.
Honestly, it's going to be a pretty tough race for her.

text_block_list.text:
Not to echo the spectators from earlier,
but Air Shakur's recent results have been in a steady decline.
A comeback might be possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Still, I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You won't lose, right?
Shakur...

Fine Motion's murmurs
somehow sounded almost like a prayer—
Amidst the roar of the crowd, the Arima Kinen got underway...!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, very.
It was a truly wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Scarlett-chan showed her usual formidable strength, but Shakur was...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She was so proud and noble.
Defying fate until the very last step.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And—they were about to move on to the next step.

Her words felt slightly out of place.
I had heard that Air Shakur was retiring, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know what Shakur will do.
Even so, she'll keep on fighting."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Because that expression you showed at the end...
was the side profile of Shakur that I love so much,
thinking solely of 'victory.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've been watching you all this time, so I know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And Shakur surely wanted...
me to see it too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I have to go.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You didn't feel anything at all? Hey...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Look at me struggling!
You still gonna give up after seeing this?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's go, Trainer.
It's almost time for the press conference."

"After this, a press conference was arranged
for her to announce her return to Japan."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey! Wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Shakur.
My mind won't change.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yet your race
was utterly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah... no good, huh?
Guess nothing's changed after all!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I got it, Fine.
This is the end—game over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it all from the start.
I lose right here, and that's the end of me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but that's borin' as hell.
I've been lookin' for somethin' that can twist the ending out of shape.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And that's when you caught my eye... Fine.
At first, I was just analyzing your data
because you were different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yet on that day, you defied all predictions.
At that exact moment... the thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If anyone can rewrite a predetermined fate...
maybe it's this one?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I change your ending—if I keep you running,
the premise collapses, and my ending should change too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I decided to believe that hypothesis...
I foolishly clung to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, in the end... everything just wraps up exactly as predicted.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still... I wonder why. In the end, nothin'
really changed, but I don't feel too bad about it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's simply because you ran your own path all the way to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So... are you sure you're okay
with that path?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so blessed, aren't I?
I really, truly am such a lucky girl.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I ran so much, made friends,
and received so much wonderful cheering."
choice_data_list: No one will ever forget the impact you made.
No one will ever forget the shock you delivered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I'm sure they won't forget.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I believe that we can become a sparkling memory—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Fine-chan!
Don't quit! Please stay in racing!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
However, my blissful three years are coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This beautiful ending
was decided from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Races begin, and then they end. Yet, within our memories, they transcend victory and defeat..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone remembers me,
my feelings will live on.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please... keep Fine Motion
in your heart, okay?

As she smiled, her eyes
sparkled brighter than ever before—
